SUBJECTS_flowworks_look_options.lead_html: Your walk, stations 24-27. Only the Scrapper tank read right; the Futuristic tank read as steampunk Industrial, the Industrial tank rusty and abandoned, the Modern tank, pipe and sprinkler cartoonish and plastic. Each row shows what ships now and the options (reference pictures, lettered in their file names) at true scale beside a vanilla human; the Scrapper tank row is there for comparison. The tank rows now hold NEW designs drawn to the look briefs: Futuristic A, B and C; Industrial C and D (beside the A and B repaints); Modern B and C (beside the A repaint). Every option shown was kept by a judge that did not make it (GPT for the new designs). Each row is prefilled with the judge's pick, a guess only. Pick one answer per row; nothing is installed until you pick, and the other tank sizes (tall, cargo, extra-tall) are drawn after in the look you pick. The four look briefs: design/specs/2026-11-22-flowworks-look-briefs/looks.md.

RM_LiquidTank.why: the Scrapper tank is the look you accept
RM_LiquidTank.context: The Scrapper tank: the look you said reads right. Shown for comparison at the same true scale; nothing is asked here.

RM_LiquidTank_Futuristic.why: GPT judge pick: the most elegant, with the clearest computerized readouts and slide-open access covers
RM_LiquidTank_Futuristic.context: Three NEW designs (generated 2026-11-22, all judge KEEP; A and B redone once to remove a drawn outline). A: white ceramic-composite capsule, cyan level bar, small graph screen, two slide-open control ports. B: graphite-black composite with magenta and cyan inlays and a long glass level window. C: brushed titanium and pale grey with amber LED readouts and flush slide-open hatches. None has an analog dial.

RM_LiquidTank_Industrial.why: GPT judge pick: D best joins maintained plant equipment with the Star Wars standard; C is the closest to a working depot tank
RM_LiquidTank_Industrial.context: A and B are colour-only repaints of the shipped drawing (A rust cleaned to gunmetal, B sand-grey paint). C and D are NEW designs (2026-11-22, both judge KEEP), each with an analog dial: C gunmetal painted steel on cast saddles, bolted manway, red hand wheel, one hazard band; D olive-drab panelled used-future tank on a steel skid with a dial, a sight glass and a hazard plate.

RM_LiquidTank_Modern.why: GPT judge pick: B, the green poly tank, is one of the real tank types you picked by card on 2026-10-23, with convincing everyday wear
RM_LiquidTank_Modern.context: A is a colour-only weathering of the shipped white leg tank (small change at play zoom). B and C are NEW designs (2026-11-22, both judge KEEP), each with an analog dial: B a UV-faded green polyethylene tank on a galvanised frame with straps, a brass tap, dirt splash and a faded label; C an off-white painted steel tank on saddles with a primer touch-up patch, smudges, a handprint and blue ball valves.

RM_UniversalPipe_Modern.context: A: touch-up patches of other paint (older darker blue, a greener batch, grey primer) on a duller, matte blue. B: sun-faded blue-grey with sparse red-oxide primer scuffs and bare-steel chips. Seams checked: 0 failures. The paint repeats once per cell (a link atlas cannot vary per cell).

RM_SprinklerHead_Modern.context: A and B match pipe A and pipe B. Either sits on either pipe.
